task1.title: Islip town centre now and planned development
task1.prompt: The maps below show the centre of a small town called Islip as it is now, and plans for its development.

chartDesc.title: Islip town centre now / Islip town centre: planned development
changes: A dual carriageway ring road is introduced surrounding the central town area
Main road converted to a Pedestrians only zone
Northern row of shops and adjacent Countryside replaced by a Bus station, Shopping centre, Car park, and New housing
Park size reduced to allow space for New housing
New housing added in the southeast section of the central ring
chartDesc.overview: The plans outline a significant redevelopment of Islip town centre, creating a pedestrianized central shopping zone enclosed by a new dual carriageway ring road, alongside new facilities such as a bus station, car park, shopping centre, and additional housing developments.
unchanged: Southern row of Shops along the main central street
Housing block in the southwest inside section
School located in the south outside the main ring road area
Housing located in the far south outside the main ring road area
keyFeatures: Introduction of a dual carriageway forming a ring road around the town centre
Pedestrianization of the central Main road
Replacement of northern shops and countryside with a Bus station, Shopping centre, Car park, and New housing
Reduction in the size of the Park and addition of New housing nearby
Preservation of southern shops, existing housing, and the school outside the main ring road

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.
